evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work

observations.why: Two matched negative clauses set in deliberate contrast — what the contract removes (blocking) and what it preserves (work) — crystallizing the design rule as opposed stakes.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Two matched grammatical branches (either polls … or gets …) arrange the two consumption paths as a balanced disjunction.
